answers.1_lattice_positions_species_reciprocal_m: silicon.save/data-file-schema.xml is the structured source; stdout also prints a human-readable subset.
answers.2_eigenvalues_and_occupations: silicon.save/data-file-schema.xml embeds ten ks_energies sections, each with four eigenvalues and four occupations. No separate eigenvalue sidecar was observed.
answers.3_wavefunction_coefficients: silicon.save/wfc1.dat through wfc10.dat contain native binary wavefunction coefficients, one file per observed irreducible k-point.
answers.4_charge_density: silicon.save/charge-density.dat records the native self-consistent charge density.
answers.5_stdout_only: The observed stdout uniquely provides the full SCF iteration-by-iteration total-energy/estimated-accuracy history, convergence prose, detailed timing/call counts, JOB DONE marker, and human-readable warnings/diagnostics not represented as such in the structured XML.
answers.6_restart_requirements: For this observed from-scratch result, reopening/restart and wavefunction-aware post-processing require the silicon.save tree: data-file-schema.xml, charge-density.dat, Si.pz-vbc.UPF, and all ten wfc*.dat files. Exact restart behavior was not executed or validated.
answers.7_compact_git_candidates: The sanitized input, compact execution-provenance JSON, result note, and this inventory/review are compact and suitable for Git. Native QE stdout/stderr and XML are small but remain external under the current deliberate-minimal retention decision.
answers.8_large_external: All wfc*.dat files and charge-density.dat remain external; the complete native silicon.save tree is retained externally.
answers.9_reproducible_scratch: The byte-duplicate top-level silicon.xml and save-directory pseudopotential copy are reproducible scratch. The wfc and charge-density files are reproducible by rerunning but remain retained external because they are native restart/post-processing evidence.
answers.10_minimum_next_extraction_inputs: Observed minimum inputs for a metadata/spectral periodic-record extraction are data-file-schema.xml plus provenance identifying the input, pseudopotential, executable, and run. Wavefunction-bearing extraction additionally requires wfc1.dat through wfc10.dat; density-bearing extraction requires charge-density.dat. Stdout is needed for iteration/convergence/timing observations not encoded equivalently in XML.
